note: Merge-base is the stale local 'main' (912992c), so this diff bundles ~5 weeks of history beyond phase 0 — reviewed as instructed. All CRITICAL/IMPORTANT findings below were verified against the actual code by the reviewer, not just relayed from sub-agents.

issues.summary: Square API failure (expired token / 5xx / outage) is swallowed by squareCallApi_ returning null -> gross written as $0.00 for the site/day (indistinguishable from a genuinely closed day), AND the staleness heartbeat is stamped because sitesWithToken++ fires on token PRESENCE (line 69), not API success. The watchdog built specifically for silent-ingest-failure stays silent through exactly that failure.

Sales-tab dedup is broken: SALES_KEY_COLS keys on the date column but rowKey_ does bare String(row[col]) with no coerceDateStr_, while every other date path in the file coerces. Sheets returns a written 'YYYY-MM-DD' as a Date object on read-back, so an existing Sales row's key ('Wed Jul 15 2026...||york') never matches the new row's key ('2026-07-15||york') -> any re-run/backfill/overlapping trigger silently appends a duplicate and double-counts gross sales, violating the date+location dedup contract in schema.md.

GAS logical-error responses are treated as success. doPost returns HTTP 200 even when validateIngest_ rejects the whole batch ({"result":"error"}). post() only calls resp.raise_for_status() (transport-only) and returns the error dict; run() prints it and exits 0. One malformed row -> entire batch silently dropped with a clean exit — the exact silent-ingest failure class behind the 'Tuga/Butterboy spend missing ~2 weeks' incident in the git log. Also untested: post() has zero coverage in test_base_connector.py.

doPost (the write/ingest endpoint) has zero authentication — no shared secret, header, or signature — while doGet is token-gated via checkReadToken_. appsscript.json deploys ANYONE_ANONYMOUS and the client sends no token, so anyone with the /exec URL (same URL published for the read side in api.md) can POST arbitrary rows straight into the Suppliers tab and corrupt every downstream Summary/report.

_resolve_review_base only checks 'git rev-parse --verify' locally, so the review gate binds to the stale local 'main' (912992c, ~29 commits / 5 weeks behind the real trunk feat/two-tab-foundation; origin has no 'main'). Every phase review diffs ~5 weeks of unrelated history instead of the phase's changes, with no warning — defeating the gate. Masked in tests because TestReviewGate mocks rev-parse to always return 'main'.

_run_test_cmd runs step['test_cmd'] via subprocess.run(shell=True) with no validation, whereas the deploy path is gated through _validate_deploy_cmd(). test_cmd is read fresh from phases/<dir>/index.json — a file the dispatched --dangerously-skip-permissions session can edit — so a misdirected session could rewrite its own test_cmd to an arbitrary command the harness then runs unconditionally (block-dangerous.js can't catch it; it hooks the in-session Bash tool, not execute.py's subprocess).

First-deploy detection trusts config/deployment.json alone. If deploymentId is ever blanked/lost, DID resolves empty and the script takes the 'clasp create-deployment' branch, silently minting a SECOND live /exec deployment — a direct violation of the 'ONE deployment id, never mint a new one' rule. No cross-check against clasp list-deployments guards it.

Non-200 API responses in ordermentum.py (and food_dairy_co.py:176) are swallowed as an empty result (return [] / {}) rather than a block/error. A 5xx for one supplier at one venue mid-run silently drops that supplier's invoices while others post normally; the run reports success with fewer rows than exist, and 'API failed' is indistinguishable from 'no invoices this period'.

Force-push guard regex requires the force flag immediately after 'push' (git push --force origin main). The natural forms 'git push origin main --force', 'git push origin --force main', and a bare 'git push -f' on a checked-out main all bypass it — exactly the teammate-overwrite incident class the hook exists to prevent.

Default credentials_login() raises bare NotImplementedError, but _attempt_auto_login only catches TransientLoginError. For connectors that don't override it (FDCo uses Cognito tokens; Kent Paper is a skeleton), if creds are present in .env and the session goes dead the unattended run crashes with an uncaught traceback instead of the intended clean mark_blocked.

Total-amount regex /(?:^|\s)Total.../ takes the first match; a two-word 'Sub Total: $450.00' line above the real 'Total: $500.00' would match first (the space before 'Total' in 'Sub Total' satisfies \s), silently ingesting the subtotal. Depends on Mayers' actual layout — flagged as a regex-construction risk, not confirmed against a live sample.

validateIngest_ doesn't require row.supplier when source==='ordermentum', but SUPPLIER_NAMES deliberately omits ordermentum. A row missing supplier falls through to the raw source string, silently merging Tuga Pastry and Butterboy spend under one bogus 'ordermentum' label.

ensureSheet never validates an existing tab's headers against SUPPLIERS_HEADERS/SALES_HEADERS. If a column is ever manually inserted/reordered in the live sheet, every subsequent appendRow writes into the wrong columns with no check.

labourWeeklyPull_ indexes col['week_start'] etc. with no existence check. A header rename/reorder in the source LABOUR_COST sheet makes col[name] undefined -> coerceDateStr_(undefined)='undefined' -> every row skipped -> returns zeros indistinguishable from 'no labour data yet', traced only by a Logger.log.

Any non-zero exit from 'git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/<branch>' (not just an unknown-revision first-push) is treated as 'first push, OK to proceed' -> exit 0, skipping the behind/rebase check. A detached HEAD, corrupted ref, or transient git error is waved through as safe.

Kent Paper skeleton has LOGIN_URL='' but run() unconditionally calls page.goto(LOGIN_URL) before any attended/unattended branching, so invoking it throws an uncaught Playwright invalid-URL error instead of the fail-safe 'not implemented' message its docstring promises.

Hook hardcodes 'git fetch origin main', but origin has no 'main' branch (default is feat/two-tab-foundation). The fetch fails every SessionStart, is swallowed by try/catch, and the hook has never performed its intended sync; it also never checks the checked-out branch before its ff-only pull.

Untested core decision logic: _eval_verdict (pass/fail/retry/escalate branching driving the live-verification gate) and _run_probe (anti-false-pass check) have no direct unit tests in test_execute.py — only end-to-end paths that stub _http_get_json before reaching them, so a branching regression would ship silently.

Project .gitignore un-ignores .claude/settings.json, .claude/hooks/, .claude/commands/ to share team config, contradicting the global rule that .gitignore must exclude .claude/. Justified in a comment, but means anything dropped into those subpaths is committed by default — worth Jake's explicit sign-off.
